subject.title: AI safety taxonomy: core event contracts and schema

question: Should AI-safety and quality signals extend the existing trusted diagnostics event model, or become a separate versioned core taxonomy?
rationale: The choice establishes a long-lived core and future plugin contract spanning security trust, privacy, exporters, and compatibility; repository inspection cannot determine that permanent product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend existing diagnostics
options.body: Add narrowly typed and versioned variants to the existing diagnostic union while preserving the trusted security-event emission boundary.

options.title: Approve separate taxonomy
options.body: Adopt a distinct AI-safety schema only after defining its ownership, compatibility, privacy, and relationship to existing security events.

options.title: Pause the core program
options.body: Keep specialized detection and evaluation semantics in plugins until a concrete missing core contract is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Extend existing diagnostics
recommendation.body: Add narrowly typed and versioned variants to the existing diagnostic union while preserving the trusted security-event emission boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The diagnostics framework history provides the strongest available signal for ownership of this core contract decision.
